svg.aria-label: The packages under internal/ in layers, highest first. front holds cli, tui, ui and i18n. app wires the rest. engine holds reaper, inspect, repair, resize and systemd. settings holds config and protect. machine holds zellij, procfs, lock and logfile. core holds policy, rename and duration, and does no I/O. An import goes down the layers, never up, and internal/layers_test.go fails otherwise.
